title: About shabitools
subtitle: Free web tools for developers and creators

mission.title: What We Do
mission.content: shabitools provides free, practical web tools that help developers, designers, and creators get their work done faster. Whether you need to format code, convert files, validate data, or check colors, we've got tools that work right in your browser.
mission.commitment: Everything is free to use. No signups required. Most tools process your data locally in your browser, so your information never leaves your device.

offerings.title: Developer Tools
offerings.description: Code formatters, validators, encoders, and utilities for everyday development tasks.

offerings.title: Design Tools
offerings.description: Color tools, contrast checkers, and visual utilities for designers.

offerings.title: General Utilities
offerings.description: Useful tools for common tasks like password generation, QR codes, and text processing.

values.title: Privacy First
values.content: Your data stays on your device. Most tools run entirely in your browser, so we never see or store your information.

values.title: Completely Free
values.content: All tools are free to use. No signups, no hidden costs, no limits on usage.

values.title: Fast & Simple
values.content: Tools load quickly and work immediately. No complicated setup or configuration needed.

values.title: Works Everywhere
values.content: Use shabitools on any device - desktop, tablet, or mobile. All tools are responsive and work across platforms.

getInvolved.title: Have Feedback?
getInvolved.content: We're always looking to improve. Here's how you can help:

ways.title: Suggest a tool
ways.description: Have an idea for a new tool? Contact us with your suggestion

ways.title: Report issues
ways.description: Found a bug or have feedback? Contact us and we'll look into it

ways.title: Share with others
ways.description: Help others discover our tools by sharing shabitools with your network

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.content: Browse our collection of free web tools and find what you need.
